name: Yinson Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Yinson Holdings Berhad 在公告中披露的业务动态主要围绕 Offshore Production 板块与 Sumitomo Corporation 就 FPSO 和 FSO 业务合作的谅解备忘录（MOU）状态更新，全年多次公告均表示该 MOU 没有重大进展。此外，公司有多项与业务无直接关联的公告，包括股息除权通知、季度业绩报告以及大量涉及收购与合并（Take-Overs & Mergers）的公告。整体上，资料中未显示各业务板块有扩张、新增、缩减或出售等具体业务变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the business-related announcements of Yinson Holdings Berhad mainly concerned status updates on the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Yinson and Sumitomo Corporation for collaboration in the FPSO and FSO business under the Offshore Production segment, with all updates stating no material development. Other announcements included dividend book closure notices, quarterly results reports, and numerous take-overs and mergers related announcements.

segments.name: 离岸生产
segments.note: 今年该板块的公告均为与 Sumitomo Corporation 就 FPSO 和 FSO 业务合作的 MOU 状态更新，均表示没有重大进展。
segments.note_en: All announcements for this segment this year were status updates on the MOU with Sumitomo Corporation for collaboration in the FPSO and FSO business, all stating no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告与 Sumitomo Corporation 就 FPSO 和 FSO 业务合作的 MOU 状态更新，表示截至公告日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced status update on the MOU with Sumitomo Corporation for collaboration in the FPSO and FSO business, stating no material development as at the date of the announcement.
